summary: First-finish smoke test of Swell Teams. Auth (signup/login/me/duplicate/wrong-password), quiz questions endpoint, users listing, DM creation, message retrieval, Swell AI chat (GPT-5.6-terra) + history persistence, and users/me PUT all work. Frontend login + sidebar nav (Activity/Chat/Swell/Calls/Files/People/Profile) render correctly; Chat opens DM with Bob, Swell page returns AI response, People and Profile pages load, profile shows ENFJ + AI bio + updated bio 'Test bio T1'. ONE HIGH-priority backend bug: POST /api/messages returns HTTP 500 due to Mongo ObjectId serialization, though the message IS persisted (visible in transcript and GET messages). Frontend surfaces a red 'Failed to send' toast on every send.
passed: POST /api/auth/signup creates user, returns token+user; duplicate email -> 400
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token -> current user (ENFJ)
GET /api/users -> excludes self (Alice sees only Bob)
POST /api/conversations kind=dm creates DM (returns id + both participants)
POST /api/swell/chat (field name is 'text') -> AI answer referencing roster (Alice ENFJ, Bob unknown)
Frontend /login -> lands on /app/chat; sidebar shows all 7 nav links
Chat: user list renders, clicking Bob opens DM, message visible in transcript
Swell page: prompt sends and AI response displayed
People page loads with search input; Profile page shows ENFJ + AI bio + communication style + updated bio

failed.issue: Returns HTTP 500 (ValueError: 'ObjectId' object is not iterable in fastapi jsonable_encoder). Message is actually written to Mongo (GET messages returns it), but the response fails serialization. Frontend consequently shows a red 'Failed to send' toast on every send in ChatPage.
failed.evidence: curl POST /api/messages -> 'Internal Server Error' HTTP 500; backend log: 'ValueError: [TypeError("ObjectId object is not iterable")...]' in fastapi/encoders.py. GET /api/conversations/{cid}/messages afterwards includes the new message. UI screenshot shows red 'Failed to send' toast while 'hello bob' message bubble is visible.

failed.issue: Review spec said /api/swell/chat takes 'question' field but backend requires 'text' (422 on 'question'). Frontend already uses 'text' so functionally OK — flagging for documentation only.

action_items: Fix POST /api/messages 500: exclude Mongo _id / ObjectId from returned document (e.g., project it out or convert). The message insert works; only the response serialization fails. This will remove the 'Failed to send' toast in ChatPage even though data was saved.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of smoke-tested flows (login, sidebar, chat open, swell, people, profile)
